rationale: I re-hashed (380a6151...) and read EO 10946 in full (26 FR 4629, May 26, 1961, Establishing a program for resolving labor disputes at missile and space sites). It creates the Missile Sites Labor Commission (sec. 1) and its committees, procedures, panels and duties (secs. 2-8) and a funding finding (sec. 9) for fiscal years 1961 and 1962. All of its commands relate to that Commission; none is a one-time performed command and none has an own-terms end. I read the held full text of EO 11374 (32 FR 14199, signed 1967-10-11): section 1 abolishes the Commission and transfers its functions to the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, secs. 2-5 continue the work, records, property and pending disputes under FMCS, and sec. 6 states 'Executive Order No. 10946 of May 26, 1961, is hereby revoked', unqualified and with no savings clause for 10946. The ACT record is scope whole. The cruden search found only EO 11374 as a later citing instrument; the API 'Revoked by' note and 1989 row agree but are leads only. I found no earlier whole ending. This supports a reviewed provisional NO; no effective date beyond signing is asserted and lifecycle questions remain open.
